recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce reportOrigin or restore primarySource to 1..1 for this issue; future changes should be handled through the later primarySource/informationSource issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-11121 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Immunization. It requested removal of the top-level reported element, addition of primarySource as a boolean, and addition of reportOrigin for non-primary report sources, while not splitting Immunization into administration and statement resources.
initial_application: Git commit baf0c978b8 explicitly applied #9205 and #11121 in 2016 by replacing reported with primarySource in examples, adding primarySource and reportOrigin to the Immunization spreadsheet, and adding the immunization-origin value set. The old spreadsheet source was later refactored into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. Later final decisions intentionally changed the literal 2016 details: FHIR-15694 changed primarySource from 1..1 to 0..1, FHIR-15696/FHIR-20327 renamed and expanded reportOrigin to informationSource[x], FHIR-32394 made informationSource a CodeableReference, and FHIR-37722 clarified the current primarySource/informationSource meanings. The combined branch already contains separate audit commits for FHIR-11187 and FHIR-15694.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no top-level Immunization.reported, defines Immunization.primarySource with later-approved optional cardinality and clarified definition, and defines Immunization.informationSource with the ImmunizationReportOrigin binding to the immunization-origin value set.
